title: Hydra — environments/<env>.yaml
description: Parameter values of one environment (dev, prod…). Used when a run selects it: `hdrctl run --env <env>`, HYDRA_ENV, or the environment selector of Studio. A parameter absent here keeps its default from parameters.yaml. Environment variables are not set here: they live in ~/.hydra/env.<env> (`hdrctl env set`), and secrets in .hydra/secrets.<env> (`hdrctl secret set --env`).

parameters.description: Parameter name → value for this environment. The value is converted to the type declared in parameters.yaml.

propertyNames.errorMessage: Parameter names use letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
